calculators.name: Dimensional and chargeable parcel weight
calculators.formula: dimensionalWeight = length * width * height / divisor; chargeableWeight = max(actualWeight, dimensionalWeight)
calculators.units: Use dimensions and divisor from the same unit system; result matches the divisor's weight unit.

calculators.name: Straight-row pallet load
calculators.units: All length inputs use one consistent unit; all weight inputs use one consistent unit.
assumptions: Geometry is not a safety approval

calculators.name: Ocean LCL weight or measure
calculators.formula: rawWm = max(totalCbm, grossMetricTonnes); chargeableWm = max(rawWm, quotedMinimum)
calculators.units: Cargo dimensions are centimetres, gross weight is kilograms, volume is cubic metres, and comparison weight is metric tonnes.
